Container.Name: mediahub
Container.Overview: A dashboard for your media server apps: Sonarr, Radarr, qBittorrent, Seerr, Plex, Unraid and more. Profiles with permissions, requests, RSS, alerts, backups and a library browser.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Port for the MediaHub web page

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Accounts, saved apps and the encryption key. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the data folder (99 is nobody on Unraid)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the data folder (100 is users on Unraid)

Config.Name: Setup code
Config.Description: Optional. If set, creating the first admin asks for this code.

Config.Name: Trust proxy
Config.Description: Set to true only if MediaHub is behind a reverse proxy or tunnel you control.
